data.property_schedule_text:
All that residential flat being Flat No. 8, situated on the Fourth Floor of the building standing on Plot No. 1A, Hauz Khas Enclave, within the limits of the New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) / South Delhi Municipal Corporation, in the Revenue Estate of Village Hauz Khas, Tehsil Hauz Khas, New Delhi – 110016, admeasuring approximately 1200 sq.ft. (One Thousand Two Hundred Square Feet) (super built-up area), and more particularly described as under:
BOUNDED AS FOLLOWS:
On the East : By common passage / staircase
On the West : By outer wall abutting neighbouring plot
On the North : By flat of another owner on the same floor
On the South : By outer wall facing the main road of Hauz Khas Enclave
On the Top : By Fifth Floor slab / terrace
On the Bottom : By Third Floor flat slab
Together with the proportionate undivided share in the land underneath the building, common areas, staircases, lifts, and open spaces as applicable, and the right to one covered car parking space in the basement / stilt area of the building.
